CI.name: Contract Start Date
CI.rule: The format of this date should be DDMMYYYY The field is Mandatory if Contract Phase=Active, Closed, Closed in advance Moreover, Contract Start Date must be less than the "Contract Reference Date".

CI.name: Contract End Planned Date
CI.rule: The format of this date should be DDMMYYYY The field is Mandatory only if Contract Phase=Active, Closed, Closed in Advance. The Contract End Planned Date must be greater than Contract Start Date.

CI.name: Contract End Actual Date
CI.rule: The format of this date should be DDMMYYYY The field is Mandatory only if Contract Phase=Closed / Closed in Advance. The Contract End Actual Date must be greater than Contract Start Date.

CI.name: Monthly Payment Amount
CI.rule: The format of the number should be Integer (no decimal). No comma, no dot The field is Mandatory if Contract Phase=Active, Closed, Closed in advance

CI.name: Last payment amount
CI.rule: The format of the number should be Integer (no decimal). No comma, no dot It is mandatory if the Contract Phase is Active, Closed or Closed in Advance

CI.name: Outstanding Payments Number
CI.rule: The format of the number should be Integer (no decimal). No comma, no dot The field is Mandatory if the Contract Phase is Active and Contract Reference Date is less than the Contract End Planned Date. It should be left empty if the Contract Phase=Closed, Closed in advance. If Outstanding Payments Number is reported, then also Outstanding Balance should be reported, and viceversa.

CI.name: Outstanding Balance
CI.rule: The format of the number should be Integer (no decimal). No comma, no dot The field is Mandatory if the Contract Phase is Active and Contract Reference Date is less than the Contract End Planned Date. It should be left empty if the Contract Phase=Closed, Closed in advance. If Outstanding Payments Number is reported, then also Outstanding Balance should be reported, and viceversa.

CI.name: Overdue Payments Number
CI.rule: The format of the number should be Integer (no decimal). No comma, no dot It should be left empty if the Contract Phase=Requested, Renounced, Rejected. If Overdue Payments Number is reported, then also Overdue Payments Amount should be reported, and viceversa.

CI.name: Overdue Payments Amount
CI.rule: The format of the number should be Integer (no decimal). No comma, no dot It should be left empty if the Contract Phase=Requested, Renounced, Rejected. If Overdue Payments Number is reported, then also Overdue Payments Amount should be reported, and viceversa.

CI.name: Overdue Days
CI.rule: The value reported should be consistent with "OverdueDaysDomain" list It is mandatory if the Contract Phase is Active, Closed or Closed in Advance
